# gcamoz — combining ability & phosphorus-use efficiency in Mozambican maize hybrids

Analyses of a 7 × 7 line × tester (NC Design II) maize trial across five environments,
supporting maize breeding for low-phosphorus conditions in Mozambique. Data and column
dictionary: `data/multilocation.csv`, `data/multilocation_dictionary.csv`.

## Paper analysis series — PUE hybrid study {#paper-series}

The manuscript's analytical framework (Joe Gage, lab meeting 2026-07-06). Each analysis is a
standalone notebook that feeds the paper's **Methods** and its **figures/tables**; all share
`R/prep_traits.R` and the 11 phenotypes grouped **A – selection** (GY, PUE), **B –
physiological** (HI, RSR, RW, SW, TDM), **C – auxiliary** (PH, DTA, DTS, ASI).

1. [Descriptive statistics, data quality & normality](descriptive_stats.html)
2. [Phosphorus treatment effects — Chokwe OPT vs STS](phosphorus_effects.html)
3. [Combining ability: ANOVA + GCA/SCA](combining_ability_anova.html)
4. [Variance components, G×E, heritability & genetic parameters (REML-BLUP)](variance_components.html)
5. Trait correlations & PUE regression · *in progress*
6. Stability (AMMI / GGE biplot) · *planned*
